verdict.rationale: BigQuery Sandbox explicitly lets users try BigQuery 'without providing a credit card or creating a billing account,' and the free tier (1 TiB queries + 10 GiB storage per month) is documented directly in pricing/marketing docs, satisfying the no-card, real-data evaluation story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience and clearer detail on sandbox feature limits (only quota/billing docs, no community confirmation of trial ease).
